articles.title: Stratification_in_Caphiria
articles.snippet:
{{Culture of Caphiria}}
In [[Caphiria]], the concept of '''social stratification''' is incredibly complex and diverse, encompassing both legal and social status. Stratification is generally hierarchical, but there are multiple and overlapping social hierarchies, and an individual's relative position in one might be higher or lower than in another. There are three distinct concepts that go into establishing one's place in Caphirian society: 
*'''Power''' (''Potestas''): A citizen's ability to do what they want despite resistance from others.
*'''Status''' (''Dignitas''): A citizen's prestige, popularity and honor or how highly society regards them.
*'''[[Social class in Caphiria|Class]]''' (''Ordo''): A citizen's legal and economic position in society.
At the peak of the social pyramid (''pyramidis societas'') is the [[Imperator]]. An Imperator has the highest ''dignitas'', ''potestas'', and is of the highest ''ordo'' in Caphirian society. If sociologists do not recognize any absolute standard for these ordinal measures than the Imperator is the relative standard to which the qualities of other residents in the empire are compared. articles.title: Magistrates_of_Caphiria
articles.snippet:
According to the Caphirian classification, a '''Magistrate''' (Latin: ''Magistratus'') is an elected bureaucratic official who has been afforded to some degree of imperium. Magistrates can be divided into two main categories: parliamentary and non-parliamentary. Parliamentary magistrates are directly involved with the government of Caphiria whereas non-parliamentary are not. Most offices are allowed to appoint a ''vicarius'' (deputy magistrate) who assists in their duties and replaces them in the event of incapacitation or death. Since ''vicariiare'' not elected, their abilities to perform the duties of a real magistrate are severely limited by the law, kept only to essential functions.

articles.title: List_of_Imperators_of_Caphiria
articles.snippet:
The [[Imperator of Caphiria]] is the popularly and aristocratically recognized chief of state and head of government for the [[Imperium of Caphiria]], wielding power over its citizens and military.

Prior to the First Imperium in the 2nd century, regions of the empire were ruled by provincial military governors answerable to and authorized by the "People and Legions of Caphiria". Caphiria and its Senate were ruled by a variety of magistrates – of whom the Imperator was the most powerful. Imperators were generals with decades long successful military careers who were able to transition into a political leadership role. With the respect of the military and the support from the people, Imperators held extreme power and influence and would eventually become the sole legal and practical dominant citizen with power over all other magistrates.

After the [[War of the Republic (109 AD)|War of the Republic]] in 109 AD, the era of the republic would end and birth the Imperium and its head of state, which took on the title of Imperator. articles.title: Foreign_relations_of_Urcea
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

The '''foreign relations of Urcea''' are the way in which the Apostolic Kingdom of [[Urcea]] interacts with the other nations of the world. Governed by the [[Ministry of State (Urcea)|Ministry of State]], Urcea's foreign policy goals include the "radical preservation" of Urcea's independence and sovereignty, which includes the maintenance of Levantia as free of foreign influence. Historically, Urcea's focus was on its relationship with other members of the [[Holy Levantine Empire]], but during the 20th century its focus shifted to its relationship with [[Caphiria]] during the [[Occidental Cold War]].

Urcea is a founding member of the [[League of Nations]] and occupies a permanent seat on the [[League of Nations Security Council]]. It is a member of the [[Levantine Union]] and the [[Nysdra Sea Treaty Association]].

==History==

Urcea's predominant foreign policy goals have shifted over time as the nation has grown from the confines of just the [[Archduchy of Urcepól]] and [[Harren|Duchy of Harren]] to a major continental power spanning most of southern [[Levantia]]. articles.title: Constitution_of_Urcea
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}
The [[Urcea|Apostolic Kingdom of Urcea]] does not have a codified constitution such as other countries tend to have. Instead of such a constitution, certain documents, precedents, and agreements stand to serve as replacements in lieu of one. These texts and their provisions therein are considered to be constitutional, such that the "constitution of Urcea" or "Urcean constitution" may refer to a number of historical and momentous laws and principles like the [[Concession of 1747]] and the [[Great Bull of 1811]] which formulate the country's body politic. Thus the term "Urcean constitution" is sometimes said to refer to an "unwritten" or uncodified constitution. The Urcean constitution primarily draws from five sources: statute law (laws passed by the [[Conshilía Daoni]] as best summarized in the ''[[Consolidated Laws of HMCM's Kingdom and State]]''), common law (laws established through court judgments), procedural conventions of the Conshilía Daoni and [[Conshilía Purpháidhe]], works of Royal authority (such as Royal decrees or concessions made by the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] to the Conshilía Daoni), and least frequently, canon law. articles.title: Government_of_Urcea
articles.snippet:
[[File:13-05-24-wien-RalfR-107.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Julian Palace]] serves as the home of the national government and the focal point and symbol for the nation.]]
The '''Government of the Apostolic Kingdom of [[Urcea]]''' is a type of dual federalist hierarchy and dual-sovereignty system. The Urcean Government is organized through a system of documents, edicts, and precedents called the [[Constitution of Urcea]], which was largely formed through the twin ideological impulses of Catholic social teaching and [[Crown Liberalism]]. Urcea's form of government, as well as its Constitution, [[Constitutional history of Urcea|developed over a period of more than a millennia]].

At all levels of state, the [[Apostolic King of Urcea|Apostolic King-Elector]] is the central organizing Constitutional basis for authority, and all who live in the Kingdom are legally understood to be “subjects”, rather than “citizens”, though the concept applies equally and the terminology is used interchangeably. The King is constrained by a series of written and unwritten constitutional precedents. The system can best be described as something of a constitutional monarchy with a semi-presidential system be

articles.title: Healthcare_in_Urcea
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}
[[File:039 Hospital de Sant Pau, edifici d'Administració, cos central i torre del rellotge.JPG|thumb|right|120px|The Carmelite Alms-Medical School at [[Collegium_Scientificum#St._John's_University|Saint John's University]].]]
'''[[Urcea]]''' has a universal multi-payer health care system paid for by a combination of statutory, state-funded health insurance officially called [[Ministry_of_Administration_of_the_Realm_(Urcea)#Agency_for_the_King.27s_Health_Aid_Administration|King's Health Aid]] (KHA) and private health-insurance. The system, which provides a public health insurance option, sees approximately 65% of citizens using the KHA System and the remaining percent using private health insurance plans. In the 2014-15 fiscal year, expenditures on the King's Health Aid was approximately $4.3 trillion dollars, or around 6% of the GDP and around $3,024 per capita.

In 2020, Urcea ranked highly in the world in life expectancy (80.5 years for men). It had a very low infant mortality rate (4.1 per 1,000 live births), and it ranked highly in the number of practicing physicians, at 3.7 per 1,000 persons. articles.title: Criminal_justice_system_of_Urcea
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

The '''criminal justice system of Urcea''' is the means by which the [[Consolidated Laws of HMCM's Kingdom and State|laws of Urcea]] are enforced. In [[Urcea]], each [[Federalism in Urcea|constituent entity]] also maintains its own criminal and civil code in addition to nationwide statutes, and most crimes are prosecuted at the subdivision level. 

==History==
Trials for crimes and civil suits in [[Urcea]] are first attested to during the medieval period, with most occurring under the auspices of arbitrators appointed by the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] or by local nobles, with irregular procedure followed in most cases. The [[Great Bull of 1811]] guaranteed the right to speedy trial by jury, establishing a baseline for civil rights of the accused, a guarantee which functionally revolutionized criminal justice. Over time, Urcean courts came to interpret the Bull's [[Great_Bull_of_1811#Eighth_Statement|Eighth Statement]] as conferring the {{Wp|presumption of innocence}}. articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

'''Urcean socialist philosophy''' is the study of the different strains of {{wp|socialist}} thought in [[Urcea]].
==Marxism==
Traditional readings of [[Carlos Marx]] have been popular in small circles in [[Urcea]] since the establishment of his works in the mid 19th century. Marx's discussion of the {{wp|Historical materialism|materialist reading of history}} described a system in which the feudal mode of production would give way to a capitalist mode followed by the creation of the socialist mode of production. Marx's view of the materialist progression, however, has caused divisions among Urcean Marxists since its inception; writing as a continental [[Sarpedon|Sarpedonian]], it was not clear to Marxists of the 19th century through today if this straight-forward model is applicable to Urcea. This fundamental disagreement led to the division of Marxists within Urcea between the "Traditionalist Marxists" and the "Particular Marxists".

The '''Protocols Act of 2023''' is an act of the [[Conshilía Daoni]] which changed the relationship between [[Urcea]] and full members of the [[Nysdra Sea Treaty Association]] (NSTA), which was also amended to reflect the Protocols Act. The Act, which amended the [[Consolidated Laws of HMCM's Kingdom and State|Diplomatic Law and the Foreign Dependencies Law]], allows the Ministries of the [[Conshilía Purpháidhe]] to directly interact with full members of NSTA without need of diplomatic protocol or use of the [[Ministry of State (Urcea)|Ministry of State]] as an intermediary. The act was intended to, in the words of the legislation's sponsor, "more fully integrate the economic and social direction of NSTA members towards the goal of mutual prosperity and security". The bill passed the Conshilía Daoni by a vote of 432-40 on March 8th, [[2023]]. It also removed the Ministry of State and [[Ministry_of_Administration_of_the_Realm_(Urcea)#Office_for_Territorial_Management|Office for Territorial Management]] as intermediaries between the Urcean government and its two union states, [[New Harren]] and [[Lariana]].

articles.title: Royal_and_Provincial_Tax_Act_of_2020
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Royal and Provincial Tax Act of 2020''' is an act of the [[Conshilía Daoni]] which made significant overhauls to the tax system of [[Urcea]]. The Act, which amended the [[Consolidated_Laws_of_HMCM%27s_Kingdom_and_State|Tax Law, Province Law, Crownland Law, and State Law]], abolished the three types of different taxes levied by the [[Government of Urcea]] on the three types of subdivisions ([[Province (Urcea)|provinces]], [[Crownland (Urcea)|crownlands]], and [[State (Urcea)|states]]). These taxes were replaced by a direct income tax on all citizens of [[Urcea]] regardless of where they lived, and also leveled various administrative fees and specific-application use taxes. The Act, which was a major campaign platform of [[Bridget Farrell]] and the [[National Pact (Urcea)|National Pact]], was passed on a party line vote of 290-210. It proved to be an extremely contentious issue in the [[2020 Urcean elections]]. In the 2021-22 fiscal year, the [[Government of Urcea]] reported a "significant surge" in state budget incomes as a result, and many analysts have suggested that the increase in taxes helped Urcea pay for the [[Final War of the Deluge]].

The national budget concerns only spending and revenue by the central government, which includes provincial administration but excludes regional and local budgets

The '''criminal justice system of Caphiria''' is part of the [[Judiciary of Caphiria]]. Responsibility for criminal law and criminal justice in Caphiria is handled by the [[Ministry of Justice (Caphiria)|Ministry of Justice]]. Caphiria's criminal justice system features three primary tiers - the investigative system, the criminal court system, and the correctional system.
== History ==
== Types and classes of crimes ==
Caphiria's Penal Code provides for three classes of crimes including felony, misdemeanor and petty offense, as well as minimum sentencing requirements and whose classifications determine what type of court tries a case

The penal law provides that the court shall determine the sentence, but provides for maximums and minimums for each type of national crime. Provinces may adopt laws assigning penalties which exceed national law, and in those cases higher courts defer to provincial law for sentencing. There are five types of crimes established nationwide - First-class Felonies, Second-class Felonies, delicts, and infractions.

The '''Judiciary of Urcea''' is the {{Wp|judicial branch}} of the [[government of Urcea]], and broadly encompasses all courts within the country ranging from the Diocesan Courts to the Archducal Court, which is Urcea's [[Prime court]]. The courts operate on a system of {{Wp|common law}} interpretations of [[Consolidated Laws of HMCM's Kingdom and State|statute]], establishing precedential rulings, and a hierarchical system of appeals. Common law, existing precedent, and the aforementioned statutes provide for the form and operation of Urcean courts. The courts are administratively overseen by Urcea's local governments or the [[Ministry of Justice (Urcea)|Ministry of Justice]]. 
==History==
Modern courts - replacing arbitrators or local nobles making decisions - gradually took form in [[Urcea]] over the late {{wp|Renaissance}} and early modern period. The [[Concession of 1747]] obtained the right to an independent approval process for judges, which would be one of the fundamental cornerstones of the later independence of the judiciary. Nominally acting as financial intermediaries of Urcea, treasury ambassadors serve as the representative of the Procurator in his role as {{wp|chief executive}} and quasi-{{wp|head of state}} role within the [[Constitution of Urcea]] in the event of a political impasse between the Procurator. [[Conshilía Purpháidhe]] ministers have broad latitude to deny or appeal decisions of the Procurator to the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]], creating potentially lengthy procedural delays [[Concilium_Purpháidhe#Procedure|related to the appeal process]]. The Treasury Ambassador Service, in these situations, allows the Procurator to continue the delicate work of foreign relations without domestic political interruption if the need presents. {{Politics of Caphiria|expanded=laws}}
The [[Imperium of Caphiria]] maintains a distinct separation between '''citizenship''' (''civitatulas'') and '''nationality''' (''agrum''). Each status carries distinct legal and political implications.

Citizenship, often considered the most prized possession for residents of the Imperium, imparts a number of privileges and rights. These include eligibility to serve in the military, compete for political offices, represent the country in diplomatic contexts, and access universal healthcare and education systems. Citizenship in Caphiria is permanent and irrevocable except in cases of severe legal transgressions such as treason, perjury, barratry, or desertion. Citizens (''cives'') also enjoy protection from capital punishment and are guaranteed the protection of the Legion when abroad. Non-citizens of Caphiria, known as ''incivile'', enjoy legal residency within the Imperium, including the rights to work and live indefinitely. However, they are barred from most public offices, do not enjoy the same voting rights as citizens, and are subject to higher income tax rates and elevated prices on goods and services.

articles.title: Coronation_of_the_Imperator
articles.snippet:
{{Culture of Caphiria}}
The '''Coronation of the Imperator''' (<small>[[Caphiric Latin]]:</small> '''Adsequela''') is the official ceremony in which the [[Imperator of Caphiria]] is formally confirmed, crowned, and enthroned as the monarch of the [[Imperium of Caphiria]]. 

The coronation is a symbolic formality and does not signify the official beginning of the Imperator's reign; ''de jure'' and ''de facto'' their reign commences from the moment of the preceding Imperator's death, maintaining the legal continuity of the state. While Caphiria's rulers have had coronation rituals going back to the First Imperium, the modern ceremony traces its origin to [[Serossaccir Odobricci|Imperator Șerossaccir]] in the late 13th century. After the [[Great Schism of 1615]], the coronation evolved into a complex religious act of consecration involving rites and rituals that took place in other Christian monarchies.

The 12 Labors of Heracles are the 12 months of service required to become a citizen of [[Burgundie]]. It is traditionally done via the [[Army of Burgundie#Standardized Militia Program|Standardized Militia]] program, but was expanded in [[2028]] by [[Crown Princess Amelia]] to include service in local government, hospitals, social work/mental health foundations, Catholic charities, or international aid  as part of her [[21st Century Burgoignesc Power Projection Stratagem]].

The 12 Labors of Heracles are named after the {{wpl|Labours of Hercules|myth}} of the same name that detail the trials and travails of the [[Istroyan]] demi-god {{wpl|Heracles}}, known by his Latin name Hercules to much of the world. It symbolizes the completion of secondary education in [[Burgundie]] and the transition to adulthood.

The vexillological standards of Burgundie, or the Burgoignesc code of flag decorum, ''Decorum della drapeaus Burgoignesc'', is the design standard for government flags of [[Burgundie]], as established by the [[Burgoignesc Code of Laws, Temporal Sins, and Their Punishments]].

It delineates flag composition for the national flags, royal flags, country flags, province flags, regional flags, county and municipal flags, as well as flags of the agencies, ministries, and departments of the government.
=Jurisdictional flags=
==National flag==
[[File:BurgFlag.png|right|thumb|Flag of [[Burgundie]].]]
The Flag of Burgundie is the basis of all national flags and sets forth the palette from which all other jurisdictional and governmental flags are derived. It is a field sanguine with a cross écotée argent. It has a badge of an eschuteon azul with a cross of St. Clement or.

The colors sanguine, azul, argent, and or are all pegged to specifical RGB color codes with are maintained across all flags and are subject to copyright law when used in combination with each other.

The '''Family Living Act''' (FLA), formally known as '''An Act to amend the Executive Law, Multiple Dwelling and Residence Law, the Public Housing Law, the Real Property Law, and the Tax Law regarding sale of homes to extended family bidding entities and the development of property for residential use''', is a landmark [[Urcea]]n law enacted by the [[Conshilía Daoni]] in [[2003]] and signed into law by King Aedanicus IX on March 23, 2003. It represents the most significant pieces of [[Housing in Urcea|housing]] and real estate law in the history of Urcea, and is considered one of the signature accomplishments of the administration of [[Procurator]] [[Michael Witte]]. 

The legislation had wide-reaching aims, including impeding the growth of {{wp|suburban}} sprawl throughout the country, reintegrating families and estates, preserving greenspace, and building durable "small urban" communities now known as the [[Housing_in_Urcea#Urban_town_and_country|Urban Town and Country (UTC)]] model.

The '''Constitutional history of Kiravia''' (Kiravic: ''Stórnoáldax axira Kiraviå'') describes the evolution of the [[Constitution of Kiravia]] over time.

==Confederative Covenant==

==Federal Constitution==

==Federal Constitution (Revised)==

==Reunification Constitution==

The Reunification Constitution introduced the framework of [[Kiravian federalism#Themes|thematic federalism]].

The drafting process for the distinguishing amendments of the Reunification Constitution was begun during the 1960s by the Planning & Actualisation Office (later the Constitutional Affairs Division) of the [[Reunification Executive]]. The Planning & Actualisation Office was charged with anticipating challenges that might arise in the event that the Revised Constitution were to come back into force on the Mainland in the near future and preparing amendments (either transitional or permanent) that might address such challenges. As time went on, the Office broadened the scope of its work, studying potential reforms of a more general nature with less direct relevance to reunification, and advising the [[Executive College]] on the same. The '''Office of the National Army,''' or '''IFN''', is one of the eight major Offices of [[Faneria|Faneria's]] government, and oversees the armed forces of the Republic. The Office itself is an administrative and mixed military and civilian organization, while actual operations are planned and performed by its component Bureaus. In Fhainnin nomenclature, the Army covers the entirety of the armed forces, leading to some confusion between the Army and the Land Bureau, the latter of which is the land army of Faneria. The Office of the Army responds primarily to the [[Seat of the Directorate|Director]] of the Republic outside of disaster situations where units are delegated to local authorities or subordinated to the [[Office of State Security (Faneria)|Office of State Security]].

articles.title: Foreign_relations_of_Burgundie
articles.snippet: [[Burgundie]] has been seen as a historical aggressor with a long history of [[Burgoignesc colonial empire|colonialism]], [[Culture_in_Burgundie#Slavery|purveyors of chattel slavery]], [[Culture_in_Burgundie#Cultural_hegemony|military and economic interventionist paternalism]], and Christian proselytization. This has led to a number of global conspiracies regarding [[Burgundie]] from [[Global Burgieman]] to [[Levantine Creep]], [[Burgophobia]], and unflattering characterizations like [[Brother Auggie]]. This attitude colors both [[Burgundie]]'s relations with the world and the world's perception of [[Burgundie|Burgoignesc]] intent. There are four types of '''elections in Pelaxia''': general elections, elections to the legislatures of the provinces (regional elections) and local elections. General elections and elections to the legislatures of the provinces are called after the mandate of the national or provincial legislature expires, usually five years after the last election, although early elections may occur. Elections to local councils (municipal and insular) are held on fixed dates but some local government bodies (including provincial councils) are not directly elected. For most elections party list PR is used for both the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate, but the plurality system is often used in local councils elections.

=General Elections=

articles.title: Asylum_in_Cartadania
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}
Seeking '''asylum in Cartadania''' is a legal right for victims of political persecution stipulated in the [[Constitution of Cartadania]]. In a wider sense, the right of asylum recognizes the definition of 'refugee' as established in the 1904 Refugee Convention and is understood to protect asylum seekers from {{wp|deportation}} and grant them certain protections under the law. Generally, these protections are a part of the asylum procedure itself and are verified by the [[Office of Asylum and Migration Services]] (OAM) without any further application. The initially unlimited right of asylum was revised in essential points and also limited by a transformation of the fundamental right of asylum into an objective guarantee was demanded in order to give the state the legal opportunity to impose an upper limit or quota.

articles.snippet: The '''Great Landsmeet''' was a socio-political institution in [[Urcea]] during the early history of Urcea. As a descendant of the [[Tribal Assembly (Great Levantia|Tribal Assembly]] of ancient [[Great Levantia]], it sat as the primary representative of the [[Estates of Urcea|estates of Urcea]] and served a quasi-legislative role in addition to being an advisory body for the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]]. It had the authority to approve or deny the levy of new taxes. The Landsmeet was first convened in 1022 and was envisioned as a way to mitigate disputes between the [[Estates of Urcea|estates of Urcea]] while also strengthening the rule of the [[Julian dynasty]] by implementing a kind of rule-by-consensus, an early example of later principles of the [[Constitution of Urcea]]. The Landsmeet only required the [[Optimate (Urcea)|optimate]] heads of Estates to convene as opposed to the earlier tribal assembly, making it a much more flexible institution to convene. In 1146, the Landsmeet was augmented with a Common Council, today's [[Conshilía Daoni]], which was intended to allow members of other social classes to provide arbitration between the Landsmeet and the King. articles.title: Great_Bull_of_1811
articles.snippet:
The '''Great Bull of 1811''' was an act proclaimed by Niall V, [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] in [[1811]]. The Great Bull, one of the last issued by an Apostolic King, deals with the civil rights of Urceans. The Bull both codified existing long-held rights as well as introduced new guarantees as part of Niall's overall liberalizing reform efforts. The Great Bull is considered one of the fundamental texts of the [[Constitution of Urcea]]. It is often referred to as the "Urcean Bill of Rights".

==Text and analysis==

The Great Bull of 1811 is formed by a preamble and nine "that" clauses, known as the nine "statements", each of which guarantees a different civil liberty. A final "that" clause binds the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] and his descendants to the contents and guarantees of the Bull. Besides the preamble and tenth statement, the nine central statements of the Great Bull each deal with a different social or political right.

The Great Bull was intended to have the effect of establishing a set of paramount rights within Urcean society. Accordingly, many of the rights enumerated under the Great Bull were previous existing legal protections. Many others, like the sixth and ninth st

articles.title: Constitution_of_Arcerion
articles.snippet:
The constitution of the '''Confederated Provinces of Arcerion''' or '''Acerion''' comprises the written and unwritten arrangements that establish the Confederacy as a political and sovereign body. While other country's constitutions are codified sets of agreements, the Arcer constitution is a loose arrangements of principles, arguments, and thesis that establish a codifying ethos and governing social structure for a society with provisions for how the rule of law and governmental functions will administer the provinces. While some constitutional lawyers have argued this leaves too much open to interpretation, the Arcer constitution is deeply rooted in [[Arco Determinism]], the governing socio-cultural ethos of the Arcer people. The Arcer Supreme Court fundamentally recognizes some obvious institutional organizations and provisions such as parliamentary sovereignty, the rule of law, and the overseeing of democracy, as well as upholding a fair and just basis for foreign and international policy.

articles.title: Energy_policy_in_Burgundie
articles.snippet:
''Energy policy in Burgundie''' is a matter of profound strategic and public health import. This complex framework is a foundational component of the most recent nation's overarching external affairs and modernization strategy, the [[21st Century Burgoignesc Power Projection Stratagem]] (SPERB XXI), proposed by [[Crown Princess Amelia]]. The nation's energy portfolio is diverse, reflecting a long-term strategy of energy independence known as ''Souverainetie Energetique''. This doctrine, forged in the wake of historical public health crises and geopolitical pressures, has resulted in a multifaceted approach to power generation that underpins [[Burgundie]]'s [[Burgoignesc Security Service|military]], [[Economy of Burgundie|economic]], and [[Foreign Relations of Burgundie|diplomatic]] ambitions.
The regulatory dualism inherent in Burgoignesc governance dictates a distinct separation of powers. The Royal Department of the Commonwealth exercises comprehensive authority over the generation and distribution of power and the specific mandate to regulate energy consumption and taxation. The '''Burgoignesc Military Compte Rendu''', is a (currently) annual top-secret report that is published by the [[Burgoignesc Security Forces]] about its strategies, tactics, posture, and most importantly, its gaps and failures. It is submitted as a corollary to the annual budget request for annual appropriations. It is released to the public 20 years after it is published and serves as a primary source for military historians on the needs and concerns of the [[Burgoignesc Security Forces]] at the time of its publication.

==Background==
During [[Operation Kipling]], affairs with [[Urcea]] were becoming extremely fraught and there was a need to identify the root causes. Geo-politically, the relationship was decaying rapidly due to [[Burgundie]]'s public openness to [[Caphiria]] despite the ongoing [[Occidental Cold War]]. However, it was the fact that [[Burgundie]]'s wars in [[Audonia]] and [[Alshar]] were increasing, and none were coming to a conclusion, at the increasing expense of [[Urcea]]'s youth and treasury, that resulted in introspection and change. The '''law of Faneria''' refers to the legal system of [[Faneria]], which operates under a modified [[Cananachan Republicanism|Quaternalist]] structure. Faneria prior to [[Fhainnin Civil War|1909]] operated on a system of common law with a number of overlapping and contradictory Royal, local, and customary legal codes which were replaced wholesale with a form of {{wp|civil law}} in stages between 1909 and 1922. Laws in Faneria are first subject to its Constitution, with Citizens', Civil, Criminal, and Commercial codes of law governing proper procedures, penalty maximums and minimums, and operational ethics within the legal system.

From the mid-90s until 2003, the [[w:Exclusive Economic Zone|Exclusive Economic Zone]] of [[Tierrador]] on the [[Orixtal Sea]] was the setting of exploitation by distant-water fleets of [[Burgundie|Burgiognesc]] fishermen and the subsequent defense of said fisherman by the [[Government of Burgundie|government]] of [[Burgundie]]. The exploitation and conflicts that resulted after were colloquially known as the [[Salmon Wars]], due to the fishermen being heavily focused on Tierradorian salmon, though other marine life, such as octopi (octopodes), cod, shark, and groupers were targeted as well.

== Background ==
[[Burgundie]], a prominent maritime nation with a vast distant-water fishing fleet, had a long history of engaging in commercial fishing ventures worldwide. [[Tierrador]], on the other hand, possessed rich fishing grounds within its exclusive economic zone (EEZ) and while fishing was vital source of revenue and employment for local communities, it was not developed on an industrial scale.

articles.title: Velvetine_Socialism
articles.snippet: '''Velvetine Socialism''' ([[Classical Latin|Latin]]: ''Socialismi Holoserica''; [[Pelaxian language|Pelaxian]]: ''Socialismo Velutíno''; [[Brenadine Tainean|Reform Tainean]]: ''Sausalism des Velaus''), also known as '''Castadillaan Socialism''', '''Democratic Revolutionary Socialism''', or '''Reformist Labourism''', is the form of socialist thought developed during the [[Velvet Revolution]] in [[Castadilla]] to realise a socialist revolution in a country ruled by a [[Estado Social (Castadilla)|nationalist dictatorship]] for decades through gradual {{wp|reformist}} means. It is the official ideology of the [[People's Democratic Party]]. Ostensibly a form of [[Livasism#Marxism-Livasism|Marxism-Livasism]], Velvetine Socialism is in practice a form of {{wp|market socialism}} with elements of {{wp|dirigism}} and {{wp|tripartism}}, though some political analysts have described the ideology as being more akin to {{wp|social democracy}} with lots of government intervention than any particular form of socialism. articles.title: List_of_political_parties_in_Castadilla
articles.snippet:
This article lists '''{{wp|political parties}} in [[Castadilla]]'''. The Castadillaan political scene has been dominated by the [[People's Democratic Party]] ever since the end of the 1984 [[Velvet Revolution]], although the [[Christian National Party (Castadilla)|Christian National Party]], alongside the [[Democratic Reform Party (Castadilla)|Democratic Reform Party]], the [[Castadillaan Citizens' Party]], and others have managed to maintain a presence in some regional and local governments.

As of 2029, the parties represented in the [[Congress of the Commons]] are the [[People's Democratic Party]] (256 [[Members of the Commons|MCs]]), the [[Christian National Party (Castadilla)|Christian National Party]] (80 MCs), the [[Democratic Reform Party (Castadilla)|Democratic Reform Party]] (56 MCs), the [[Castadillaan Citizens' Party]] (53 MCs), the [[Democratic Farmers' Union]] (35 MCs), the [[Ecological Reform Party]] (8 MCs), [[Yes We Can!]] (7 MCs), and the [[Delepasian Alternative]] (5 MCs). Exclusively regional political parties are almost non-existent except for in [[Samalosi]].

articles.title: Coronation_of_the_Castadillaan_Emperor
articles.snippet:
[[File:Coronation_of_George_VI_1937.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Philip I of Delepasia|Philip I]] receiving the homage after being crowned in 1952]]
The '''{{wp|coronation}} of the [[Castadillaan Emperor]]''' is a formal ceremony in which the Emperor is formally invested with the [[Imperial Crown of Castadilla|imperial regalia]] and is crowned at the [[Primatial Basilica of Las Joquis]]. It takes inspiration from coronations that have been historically performed in other monarchies in the [[Occidental]], with many traditions dating back to the middle ages, as well as the traditions maintained in [[Caphiria]] for their [[Coronation of the Imperator|imperial coronations]]. Historically, [[Vallos]] had numerous coronations ever since the official introduction of Occidental-style monarchies at the beginning of the [[Caphiric Undecimvirate in Vallos|Undecimvirate era]], but these events were much smaller affairs and were more of a confirmation of the [[Imperator]]'s suzerainty over the kings; the first larger-scale coronation would be happen until the [[Viceroyalty of Los Rumas|colonial era]] when the Viceroyalty was established alongside a new set of viceregal regalia to represent the [[Pelaxia|P

articles.snippet:
==Metropolitan relations==
{{Further|Kiro-Burgoignesc Wars}}
==Island relations==

Trade and ecological cooperation between [[Kiravia]] and the [[Burgundie|Burgoignesc]] isles of [[Nauta Normand]] and [[Wintergen]], is the result of the harsh realities of their northern climes.

At the heart of this relationship lies the historical juncture where the Burgoignesc islands grappled with the challenge of meeting their energy needs without compromising their extensive tree plantations. [[Kiravia]], by proximity, emerged as a key ally, providing peat as a reliable fuel source, despite the fact that the metropoles were often in conflict. This, in the minds of the [[Kiravia]]ns exemplified the concept of [[Brother Auggie]].
For over a century, peat stood as the primary energy source in [[Nauta Normand]] and [[Wintergen]]. Its efficient burn and consistent warmth made it the cornerstone of heating systems, despite geopolitical tensions. The pragmatic need for this indispensable resource fostered an enduring trade relationship, transcending political divides between the locals and the [[Kiravia]]ns with whom they dealt.

articles.snippet:
{{wip}}
==2034 Vallejar-Burgundie Maritime Security Initiative==
===Background===
During the first quarter of 2034, the Ministry of Security and Justice of Vallejar notified the government of a significant and concerning increase in insecurity and cases of attempted robbery, kidnapping, and damage to merchant, commercial, leisure, fishing vessels, and any others in Vallejarian seas, as well as everywhere in the world for fully Vallejarian vessels. The rise in cases occurred on May 1, 2034, with exact figures indicating an increase from 85 to 194 cases of attempted robbery, kidnapping, and damage to all types of vessels. Additionally, there were material losses of 4 fishing boats, 2 cruisers, and 3 merchant and commercial ships. Economic losses are also reported, as the value of stolen, kidnapped, sunk, or degraded goods, rendering them economically unprofitable, amounts to approximately 347.8 million. articles.title: Government_of_Canespa
articles.snippet:
[[Canespa|Canespa's]] government is one of the most unique in the world. Dominated by an industry of agriculture the state became controlled and eventually merged with the company that controlled the industry. This creates a form of government some call a Congressional Company, or Potato Republic. Either way this form of government exists no where else on the planet and is completely unique to [[Canespa]]. A government that while not a complete dictatorship, is not the most democratic either. There is even a monarch like system within the government caused by the influence of [[Canespa|Canespa's]] past.

articles.snippet:

The '''Pareto Associations''' were six different leagues of states within the [[Kingdom of Dericania]] formed in the 17th through 19th centuries. The associations took the form of six year compacts signed in the Prince-Bishopric of [[Pareto]] (in modern [[Rhotia]]) which gave the alliances their name. These alliances were generally established for the purpose of containing the growing power of [[Urcea]] by means of deterence and preventing Urcea from expanding into Dericania. Urcea's centralization and reforms, as well as its territorial gains, made it one of the preeminent powers in the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] after the [[Great Confessional War]] with few peer powers. The first Association was established in [[1611]] and the final one established in the leadup to the [[Third Caroline War]], after which time they were prohibited by treaty. Perhaps the most well known of the Associations was the Second Pareto Association, which included the nascent [[Verecundia|Duchy of Vercuna]], [[Faramount]], [[Pravenza]], [[Hollona and Diorisia]], and a number of smaller entities such as Pareto. In [[1925]], the [[Vilaurustre]] defenses were expanded and coastal defenses and flak towers were added. The bunker system built to support these were used as the basis in [[Marialanus (province)|Marialanus]] for a similar system in [[1927]]. The military utility of the bunkers in Northern [[Levantia]] faded as the [[Great War]] shifted from [[Levantia]] to [[Ixnay]] and then [[Crona]], but as the development of long-range, high altitude bombers rendered traditional anti-aircraft measures obsolete, [[Burgundie]] decided to expand the bunkers of the 1920s. articles.snippet:
[[File:Tierrosphere expansion.png|thumb|Commonly-associated extent of the Tierrosphere]]

The '''Tierrosphere''' is a predominantly [[South Crona|South Cronan]] area that is considered to be under the historical, economic, cultural, and military influence of the [[Tierrador|Tierradorian Woqalate]]. The current extent of the Tierrosphere is widely agreed on as [[Tierrador]], [[Ceylonia]], [[Porlos]], [[Istrenya]], and [[Atapakona]], which had historically been dominated as former colonies or vassals by the [[Qabóri Woqalate]]. Other nations sometimes included are [[Kabasa]], [[Umardwal]], and [[Kujalleq]]. All five of the main Tierrosphere nations feature very similar characteristics culturally, as their dominant indigenous culture stemmed mostly from [[Abioic civilization]], the dominant South Cronan culture group. While the Tierrosphere is not a recognized international organization by the governments of the aforementioned nations, it usually is referred to in official documents and meetings between leaders, media organizations, and scholars within those countries.

articles.title: Elections_in_Castadilla
articles.snippet:
'''Elections in Castadilla''' are held for the three territorial levels of government once every four years. An election cycle in Castadilla starts in May and lasts until November, starting with local elections on the municipal level and ending with the legislative election on the national level. {{wp|Referendum|Referendums}} are also held occasionally, but they exist outside of the standard electoral cycle and may be called at any time. This page will also explore pre-1996 election cycles which are often organised differently from modern election cycles in the country.

On the national level, it is the [[National Assembly of Castadilla|National Assembly]] that serves as the nation's {{wp|legislative branch}} in government. The National Assembly is a {{wp|bicameralism|bicameral}} legislature, and is split between the 300-member [[Congress of the Peerage]], the {{wp|upper house}}, and the 600-member [[Congress of the Commons]], the {{wp|lower house}}; both are elected by {{wp|proportional representation}}. articles.title: Political_ideologies_in_Castadilla
articles.snippet:
Formal '''political ideologies in Castadilla''' are aligned based upon the {{wp|left-right political spectrum}}, an axis used to classify political positions in relation to their emphasis on either social equality or social hierarchy. Most [[Castadillaans]] identify as at least one of four main ideologies: {{wp|socialism}}, {{wp|liberalism}}, {{wp|conservatism}}, and {{wp|nationalism}}; it is very common for one to identify as being any combination of two of the four main ideologies, with {{wp|political polarization|political polarisation}} being largely miniscule for the most part thanks to the four ideological groups more or less cooperating with each other during the era of the provisional government after the end of the [[Velvet Revolution]].

[[File:Castadillaan passport.svg|thumb|250px|A [[Castadilla passport|Castadillaan passport]]. Passports are considered a valid form of identification as well as valid proof of nationality; all Castadillaan nationals have the right to acquire and use a Castadillaan passport.]]
'''Citizenship law in Castadilla''' is a series of laws which determine who gets conferred Castadillaan nationality and who gets conferred Castadillaan citizenship. In [[Castadilla]], nationality and citizenship are both seen as two separate but interconnected legal concepts with the former often being referred to as the basic levels of citizenship in most other nations while the latter refers to the rights that are conferred to a citizen upon reaching the {{wp|age of majority}}.

Castadillaan citizenship law is partially based on the [[Caphirian nationality law|Caphiric nationality law]] which also maintains that nationality and citizenship are separate legal concepts. A civil service official, also known as a public sergeant ([[Burgoignesc language|Burg]]: ''sergent publique''), is a person employed in the public sector by a ministry, department, or agency of the [[Government of Burgundie]], for public sector undertakings. Public sergeants work for the national, constituent, provincial, and local governments, and answer to the government, not a political party.

articles.snippet:
In recognition of the trials we have faced, in acknowledgment of our diverse culture, and in hope for the future we might share, this, the Second Constitution of Olmeria, is hereby established. With this we ensure that all the people of this nation shall be equals in opportunity, shall have fair voice in governance and shall be treated justly by all. It is with this commitment that we embark on the creation of a new, free Olmerian state that may serve us all with dignity.

=== Chapter 1: Rights and Principles ===
Protecting the rights of the Olmerian people, and all people who set foot on the isle of Tarsa, must be the states first and foremost priority. The chapter here inscribed entrenches those absolute rights, essential in any free nation, in a higher law, such that no government may infringe on them, and they may be upheld most strongly by the courts of law.

articles.title: Government_of_Fiannria
articles.snippet:
[[File:All-Tyn.jpeg|thumb|right|250px|The [[New All-Tyn]] serves as the home of the legislative branch of the federal government and seat of historical constitutional and legal power in the Commonwealth.]]
The Commonwealth of Fiannria is the oldest surviving Republic and Democracy in Levantia. It is a constitutional republic and with a federal semi-presidential system of government. The government is organized and established by a series of documents and edicts together that together establish the [[Constitution of Fiannria]]. The Commownealth is organized under three branches of government, the executive branch, headed by the President of the Commonwealth and the Chancellor of the All-Tyn, the legislative branch, made up of the All-Tyn, Fiannria's unicameral legislature, whose 520 seats are made up of representative members of the Tyn from each of the Commonwealth's States and Baillies, and the judicial branch, headed by the 7 member High Court of the Commonwealth along with the federal court system.

{{Politics of Nasastan}}

The '''Ministry of Foreign Affairs''' of [[Nasastan]] is the executive body responsible for conducting and coordinating the foreign policy of the National Federation of Nasastan. In [[Pomorskitong]], the ministry is officially known as ''Mińztria z zdalekamysli'', a term more directly translatable as Ministry of Foreign Relation. Despite this semantic difference, the English-language name has remained unchanged due to continuity with earlier institutional usage. The ministry is commonly abbreviated as MZM.

articles.title: Rota_system
articles.snippet:
[[File:Election of Stanisław August Poniatowski in 1764 (detail).PNG|thumb|Election of [[Rej Ziółkowski|Rej I Ziółkowski]] in 1755]]
The '''Rota System''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Rotacéa'', lit. "Rotation") was the electoral succession system used by the [[Grand Duchy of Nasastan]] and later the [[Kingdom of Nasastan]] between 1722 and 1832. Under the system, the reigning monarch was not automatically succeeded by his eldest son. Instead, upon the death of a Grand Duke or King, members of the Uprawa assembled to elect a new ruler from among eligible members of the [[Ziółkowski dynasty]]. Originally established as a compromise between dynastic legitimacy and [[Kallistocracy|Kallistocratic]] distrust of hereditary entitlement, the Rota System became one of the defining institutions of 18th century Nasastan. Although intended to prevent unfit rulers from inheriting power, the system gradually evolved into a mechanism through which religious authorities, aristocratic factions, and powerful families competed for influence over succession.

The system formally survived for more than a century but underwent significant transformation over time. While genuinely competitive during its early de

articles.snippet:
[[File:Sejdza Internet Poster.png|thumb|533x533px|Drawing of a poster by Below273, circulated on the internet as an expression of pride in the Sejdzas sandbox methodology. The poster portrays [[Nasastan]] as an unusually flexible state committed to promoting human happiness (seen as real progress), in contrast to other states. It was frequently reposted online prior to the establishment of [[Alekšander Nesura|Nesuras]] firewall.]]
'''Sejdzas sandbox''' is a term used in political science to describe a characteristic mode of policymaking historically associated with [[Nasastan]] and its predecessor states. The concept describes the deliberate alteration and experimental implementation of existing political, economic, social, or institutional systems while retaining an identifiable means of reversing the intervention if it produces an unacceptable outcome. It is generally divided into two principal phases, Sejdzaisation and sandboxing, preceded by an analytical process commonly termed pre-Sejdzaisation. articles.title: Mass_surveillance_in_Nasastan
articles.snippet:
'''Mass surveillance in Nasastan''' refers to the large-scale collection, retention, processing and administrative use of information concerning the population of [[Nasastan]] by state institutions and associated organizations. Although surveillance practices existed in rudimentary forms before the establishment of the modern system, mass surveillance is generally considered to have begun ''de facto'' in 1951 and to have become institutionalized during the late 1950s and 1960s. The contemporary Nasastani system differs substantially from conventional secret-police models. Whereas surveillance during the early 1950s was principally directed against political opponents and groups regarded as threats to the state, the post-1950s system increasingly treated information as an administrative resource. Surveillance became associated with public administration, judicial proceedings, healthcare regulation, security, demographic policy and, eventually, digital services and artificial intelligence.

It was founded in 1907 as one of the earliest bodies of the [[Faneria|Fhainnin Popular Republic]]. Its creation, at the time, was simply as a tax collection agency to allow the setup of a proper government in liberated territories under the Republican government during the [[Fhainnin Civil War]], after which it took over the responsibilities of minting currency and legal documents, as well as providing some internal banking services for the government and public employees.

articles.title: 2015_Urcean_political_realignment
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

The '''2015 Urcean political realignment''' was a series of events that lead to the [[2015 Urcean elections|2015 elections]] in [[Urcea]] becoming a realigning election, dissolving the two-party duopoly that had existed in [[Urcea]] since the end of the [[Red Interregnum]]. The more than a century old [[Commonwealth Union (Urcea)|Commonwealth Union]] was destroyed, dissolving into the rival [[Union for National Solidarity (Urcea)|Union for National Solidarity]] and [[Social Labor Party (Urcea)|Social Labor Party]]. The realignment had the practical effect of dividing the mainstream Urcean left from the primary {{wp|big tent}} party, the Commonwealth Union, allowing the emergence of a distinctly [[Wittonian Socialism|Wittonian Socialist]] and {{wp|monarchist}} party - the [[Solidarity Party (Urcea)|Solidarity Party]] in [[2025]].

== Background ==
The Commonwealth Union was formed out of a coalition of non-partisan reform-minded politicians aligned with [[Gréagóir FitzRex]] elected to the [[Conshilía Daoni]] in 1895. articles.title: Administrative_Reorganization_Act_of_1892
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Administrative Reorganization Act of 1892''' was [[Index of Urcean legislation|an act]] of the [[Urcea|Urcean]] [[Conshilía Daoni]] during the [[History_of_Urcea_(1798-1902)#Crown_Regency_and_Red_Interregnum|Crown Regency]] of [[Gréagóir FitzRex]]. The Act eliminated the last vestiges of feudal political organization by sweeping away a large number of crownlands, provinces, free cities, counties, [[Plantatía]]r, duchies, and {{wp|Imperial circles}} and subsequently began a nation-wide survey of land in order to redraw provincial boundaries and to create [[Local government in Urcea|rational local governments]], a process which was mostly completed in 1895. The Act was intended to create a {{wp|federalism|federal}} political structure in [[Urcea]] based on the principles elucidated in the [[Great_Bull_of_1811#Fifth_Statement|Fifth Statement]] of the [[Great Bull of 1811]]. The Act exempted three crownlands - the [[Urcepól (Archduchy)|Archduchy of Urcepól]] and the [[Harren|Grand Duchy of Harren]] - since it was unclear from the [[Constitution of Urcea]] and [[Golden Bull of 1098]] if these two integral parts of the Kingdom could be legally abolished. articles.title: The_Enabling
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

'''The Enabling''' was a political controversy in [[Urcea]] during the early 1900s which took place during the [[History_of_Urcea_(1902-1943)#Restoration|Restoration era]]. Following the conclusion of the [[Red Interregnum]] enactment of the [[Constitutional Settlement Act of 1902]], Urcea's [[Constitution of Urcea|Constitutional order]] remained fragile or non-existent, and the next regularly scheduled election was not to occur until 1905. Accordingly, the [[Conshilía Daoni]] passed the Enabling Act of [[1903]], which gave the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] extraordinary executive powers (including those normally reserved to the [[Procurator]]) until such time of an election could take place. The extent of this act - expiring in 1905 - created significant disruption among the [[National Pact (Urcea)|National Pact]], which [[Patrick III of Urcea|Patrick III]] selected to form a provisional government in his name. Members of the party from the [[Ionian Plateau]] - a traditionally Royalist area - sought the Enabling Act to be effective until 1910 and sought "Royal reconstruction" of the nation, prioritizing the strong hand of the King in restoring the economy, security, and in

Golden_Bull_of_1098
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Golden Bull of 1098''' was a {{wp|Golden bull|golden bull}} issued by [[Saint Charles II|Emperor Charles II]] in [[1098]] which reorganized the [[Southern Kingdom of the Levantines]] as the [[Imperial Kingdom of Urcea]] and conveyed the title of King on the [[Julian dynasty]]. It is the constituting act which established [[Urcea]] as a cohesive political entity, and remains the foundational legal act on which the Kingdom is based. The Julian dynasty had been the most powerful political force within the Southern Kingdom since the unification of [[Urcepól (Archduchy)|Urcepól]] and [[Harren]], the two realms which were fused by the golden bull and established as the two integral parts of the new Kingdom. Under the terms of the Golden Bull of 1098, all previous vassals of the Southern King of the Levantines were transferred to the new [[Apostolic King of Urcea]], although in practice many continued to have considerably autonomy or effective {{wp|imperial immediacy}}.

This is a list of active [[Political parties in Urcea|Urcean political parties]] who have elected at least one member of the [[Conshilía Daoni]]. Within the context of this article, a "major party" is defined as one which has concurrently held more than 15 seats in the Daoni at any one time, whereas a minor party is an extant party that has not achieved that threshold but has elected members to the Daoni in recent decades.

==Major parties==
===National Pact===
{{Main|National Pact (Urcea)}}
[[File:National Pact Logo.png|thumb|left|250px|Logo of the National Pact]]
The '''National Pact''' is Urcea's oldest political party. It is the party of [[Crown Liberalism]], and the central ideology of the party is the maintenance of the [[Constitution of Urcea|constitution]] and economic liberalization. As part of its constitutionalist plank, the National Pact is partly a centralist party, though in many respects this takes less the form of being against the modern [[Federalism in Urcea|federalist system as a whole]] but rather as specific preferences for the national government in making policy decisions as opposed to the provinces. Empire-in-fact
articles.snippet:
The '''Empire-in-fact''' is a legal term describing the current state of the [[Holy Levantine Empire]], and it is commonly used in political contexts to refer to the Empire as a {{wp|legal fiction}}. The term originates from the [[Treaty of Corcra]], which among many other provisions provides that the "Empire-in-fact persists in the person of the [[Emperor of the Levantines|Emperor]]."
[[File:Austria-03356 - Austrian Imperial Crown (32121434203).jpg|thumb|right|250px|The continued use of the [[Julian_Throne_and_Crown_Jewels_of_Urcea#Imperial_State_Crown|Imperial State Crown]] by the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] is one of the most prominent symbols of the theoretically continued existence of the Holy Levantine Empire.]]
==Concept==
The Empire-in-fact, as the terms of the [[Treaty of Corcra]] suggest, refers to the fact that the Holy Levantine Empire no longer exists as a distinct geopolitical body as it did between the medieval period and the [[Second Great War]]. The discontinuation of the Empire occurred during the war as a compromise poisiton to end fighting in [[Dericania]]. Despite being the highest court in Faneria, the NAC does not act as a final arbiter on appeals, which are handed down to High Courts; instead, it is tasked with the management of the court system and the power of {{wp|judicial review}}, as well as being the body primarily responsible for impeachments within the [[Cananachan Republicanism|Cananachist]] structure of government.

articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

The '''Retainer Party''', '''Retainer Coalition''', or '''Pink Coalition''' refer to a semi-official alliance between the [[Union for National Solidarity (Urcea)|Union for National Solidarity]] and pro-[[Apostolic King of Urcea|monarchy]] members of the [[Social Labor Party (Urcea)|Social Labor Party]] in the [[Conshilía Daoni]]. The Coalition, established in September 2017, was formed in the wake of the vote scheduling the [[2018 Urcean institutional referendum]] on the future of the Monarchy.

The Retainer Party aims to be the primary pro-Monarchy campaign arm in the [[2018 Urcean institutional referendum]] as its primary purpose. It additionally functions as an organized bi-partisan opposition to the majority [[National Pact (Urcea)|National Pact]] elected in [[2015 Urcean Conshilía Daoni election|2015]], and seeks to preserve's [[Urcea]]'s welfare state and the present [[Constitution of Urcea]].

In the [[Burgoignesc colonial empire]], a patroon was a landholder, typically [[Mercantile Reform Protestant]], with manorial rights to large tracts of land in the 17th and 18th century. The practice was particularly common in [[Audonia]] and [[Vallos]], and formed the basis for the existence and organization of [[Equatorial Ostiecia]].

During the [[Great Confessional War]], staring in [[1573]] Emperor Leo III, of the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] started a campaign of [[dragonnades]] across the [[Kingdom of Angla]] and the [[Kingdom of Dericania]]. This practice of billeting ill-disciplined troops in prominent Protestant households in order to convince the leaders of Protestant communities to convert to Catholicism or leave [[Levantia]]. It was considered inhumane by the Duke of Bourgondia, who offered aid to the protestants who sought to leave. In exchange for their fluid capital, he granted them patroonships in [[Torlen]], [[Medimeria]], and then in the [[Burgoignesc Kandahar-Kandara Trading Company|Ularien Trading Company]] colonies in [[Audonia]], and [[Alshar]]. articles.title: Nolanism
articles.snippet:
{{Stub}}

'''Nolanism''' is a strain of {{wp|liberalism|liberal}} thought within [[Urcea]] that advocates the complete adoption of liberal social and economic ideas while remaining neutral on political issues such as the structure of the [[Constitution of Urcea|constitution]] or [[Apostolic King of Urcea|monarchy]] for pragmatic reasons. Nolanists are generally regarded as a radical strain of {{wp|conservative liberalism|conservative liberals}}, with the ideology calling for no accomodation with ancient institutions in Urcea such as the [[Guilds (Urcea)|guild system]], the established [[Catholic Church]], and the prevalence of so-called vice laws. Nolanism is generally opposed to [[Crown Liberalism]] and views the emancipation of the individual and enshrinement of {{wp|civil rights}} at the center of Urcean society as its chief aims. Adherents of the ideology also denounce {{Wp|socialism}} and various left-wing movements, feeling that they often make the monarchy a politically distracting issue while making their civil rights-oriented goals more easily subject to {{wp|strawman}} dismissals. The ideology is named for Linar Orens-Nolan, a onetime [[National Pact (Urcea)|National Pact

articles.title: 1967_Urcean_political_crisis
articles.snippet:
The '''1967 Urcean political crisis''' was a major breakdown in the systems of the [[Government of Urcea|government of Urcea]] that began in February [[1967]] and lasted until May [[1967]]. During that period, the [[Conshilía Daoni]] did not meet, the longest such period in the modern history of the Daoni. The crisis, which introduced questions about the [[Constitution of Urcea|Urcean constitution]] into the public sphere, was ultimately resolved with a complex arrangement of [[Apostolic King of Urcea|Royal]] appointments as well as {{wp|confidence and supply}} agreements.

==Background==
{{Main|Urlazio Synod}}
In the 1955 Urcean elections, the [[Commonwealth Union (Urcea)|Commonwealth Union]] won a major victory, continuing a string of victories going back several decades. John Donnula was elected both [[Procurator]] and [[Chancellor and Temporary President]] of the [[Conshilía Daoni]]. A decade later, in the 1965 Urcean elections, the Commonwealth Union retained its majority with 257 seats. The [[National Pact (Urcea)|National Pact]] won 221 seats, and the [[Julian Party (Urcea)|Julian Party]] won 22 seats.

articles.title: Elections_in_Urcea
articles.snippet:
[[File:Luke Ravenstahl Voting.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A man filling out a paper ballot during the [[2035 Urcean elections]].]]
'''Elections in Urcea''' are held for all national and [[Federalism in Urcea|provincial]] offices and most [[Local government in Urcea|local]] offices. At the national level, the [[Procurator]] is directly elected by the Urcean people. All members of the [[Conshilía Daoni]] are elected directly by people in each province, crownland, or state.  Governors and local legislators of the provinces, states, and crownlands are also directly elected, as are the officials of municipalities using an [[Local government in Urcea#Executive polis|executive polis]] model. There are also a number of special districts which hold elections on a local level. The modern system of Urcean elections can mostly trace its history back to the [[Constitutional_history_of_Urcea#Concession_of_1747|Concession of 1747]].

Elections in Urcea are highly decentralized and are primarily administered by [[Civil diocese (Urcea)|Diocesan Boards of Election]], who set forth local rules, establish eligibility lists and voter rolls, physically own and maintain voting machines,  count votes, and certi

articles.title: Political_parties_in_Urcea
articles.snippet:
{{About||a comprehensive list of parties|List of Urcean political parties}}

Urcean {{wp|electoral politics}} have largely been dominated by successive pairs of major political parties since shortly after the [[First Great War]], succeeding a century of uncontested domination by the [[National Pact (Urcea)|National Pact]], broadly considered the first organized political party in Urcean history. Urcea has a tradition of smaller regional third parties (such as the [[Julian Party (Urcea)|Julian Party]]) as well as typically having a small [[Urcean socialist philosophy|socialist]] or left-wing party which wins third or fourth place in most [[Conshilía Daoni]] elections. The National Pact has been opposed by a succession of related parties; the [[Commonwealth Union (Urcea)|Commonwealth Union]], the [[Union for National Solidarity (Urcea)|Union for National Solidarity]], and the modern [[Solidarity Party (Urcea)|Solidarity Party]], each of which descended from the preceding political party representing a reformist, {{wp|Integralism|integralist}} perspective contrary to the [[Crown Liberalism|crown liberal]] National Pact. articles.title: Royal_Treasury_(Urcea)
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Royal Treasury''' of [[Urcea]] is the primary organ of the [[Government of Urcea]] within the [[Constitution of Urcea|Urcean constitution]]. The Treasury is not a distinct institution as such, but refers functionally to the entire government, which allocates, receives, disburses, and spends funds. The beginnings of the Urcean government lay in the creation of the [[Conshilía Daoni]] under the authority of the [[Procurator]] - the Royal Steward - in [[1146]] and the subsequent inclusion of the [[Conshilía Purpháidhe]] under the Procurator in the late medieval period. Consequently, most elected officials on the national level are considered to be officers of the treasury, including all members of the Daoni. The Procurator, in addition to his title as Royal Steward, is head of the Treasury in his title of First Lord of the Treasury; the Purpháidhe ministers serve as the Lords of the Treasury and once were afforded tertiary honorific titles such as "Second Lord of the Treasury", etc., though use of these have been abolished. articles.title: Local_government_in_Urcea
articles.snippet:
[[File:FEMA - 32463 - SBA at Findlay Town Meeting in Ohio.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A meeting of the communal assembly in Icron, [[Ardthirium]], in [[2010]].]]
[[Urcea]] is divided into thirty-four constituent entities (known variously as [[Province (Urcea)|provinces]], [[Crownland (Urcea)|crownlands]], or [[State (Urcea)|states]]) which are further subdivided into dioceses and then municipalities. Local government throughout Urcea retains the same form throughout the provinces, though in some instances the nomenclature and titles of officeholders and public institutions may vary. Every part of Urcea is incorporated within a municipal government, precluding the use of {{wp|unincorporated area}}s. 

Municipalities play an important role in the function of public administration in Urcea, and they typically take on three distinct forms of government. They are the primary instruments through which basic public services are provided to Urceans, including running water, local road maintenance, and the provision of public education. articles.title: Plantatía
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Plantatía''' ("Plantation", plural "Plantatíar") was a [[Urcea]]n unit of government created to hold jurisdiction over areas in the Urcean periphery of [[Levantia]], particularly those settled by [[Ómestaderoi]] specifically or by [[Riparians]] generally. The system was created in the Leonine Land Decree of [[1590]] and subsequently clarified. This included lands conquered or incorporated into Urcea as well as areas within Urcea made settleable by means of internal improvements such as reservoirs or draining. When created, Plantatíar would not replace the local feudal-era duchy or county but would instead supersede it in some regards, particularly as it related to the management and organization of multiple settler towns and administration of justice to people living therein. Interaction with the older heredtiary constituencies became political rather than feudal in nature as the settlers [[Land_ownership_in_Urcea#Freehold|typically held their land in their own name]] rather than as [[Land_ownership_in_Urcea#Leasehold|leaseholds]]. Successfully created settlements would later have charters granted to them as [[Local_government_in_Urcea#Civil_commune|civil communes]

articles.title: Province_(Urcea)
Crownland_(Urcea)
State_(Urcea)
Federalism_in_Urcea
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}
'''Federalism in Urcea''' describes both the federal governance system of Urcea, employing thirty-four [[Province (Urcea)|provinces]], [[Crownland (Urcea)|crownlands]], and [[State (Urcea)|states]], as well as attitudes and ideologies related to its use. Federalism, which finds its roots in many different areas including Urcea's feudal past and the concept of {{wp|Subsidiarity (Urcea)|subsidiarity}} among other sources, is a key part of the [[Constitution of Urcea]] and comprises a significant part of the political life of most Urceans. The thirty-four constituent entities of Urcea have significant latitude to pass laws, implement programs, and prosecute violators, playing an important role in shaping regionalized variations of Urcea's [[Economy of Urcea|economy]] and [[Society of Urcea|society]]. The provinces and other entities are also the primary organizing unit of many different institutions, including its [[Judiciary of Urcea|courts]], [[Local government in Urcea|local governments]], [[Guilds (Urcea)|guilds]], [[Political parties in Urcea|political parties]], and even the [[Urcean Conference of Catholic Bishops|Catholic Church hierarchy]] within the country. articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

The title of '''Augustus''' is used to refer to the {{Wp|paramount leader}} of [[Great Levantia]] between the reign of [[Gaius Stephanus Pictor]] and the end of the state in [[502]] AD. 

The term is a historiographic convention and slightly anachronistic. The honorific of ''Augustus'' was not used until the reign of the Pontifex Maximus Gnaeus I, who ruled in the late 1st and early 2nd century AD. However, it is the preferred nomenclature because of the swift succession of constitutional responsibilities of the chief officer of state from Pontifex to Magister Militum and finally to Emperor that occurred over the course of the 2nd and 3rd centuries AD. Though the constitutional positions changed, the role in the state of the man holding the title of Augustus remained similar throughout this period, and so it is applied to all three offices by historians as a shorthand.

==Concepts==
The role of Augustus should be understood as a kind of office within the Levantine republican political system rather than as a later monarch.
